horizon: prediction_month T to exact next calendar month T+1
prediction_input_contract: One row per district_key + commodity_name + prediction_month + currency_code. Provide all listed numeric predictors using information available by T. Rainfall features end at T; price lag/history features end at T; one-hot commodity columns use the saved vocabulary. Never pass target_month price/SPI/stress. Population baseline in the saved feature data has reference period 2023 and historical availability before 2023 is not established.
